public_definitions: Goal: Review the renewable generation dashboard, identify the largest renewable generation contribution source, then route that source record to priority contribution follow-up.
Routing criterion: Largest renewable generation contribution source
Option: Route Solar for priority contribution follow-up
Option: Route Wind for priority contribution follow-up
Option: Keep Hydroelectric on routine contribution monitoring
